title: Make a choice
summary: Ruby: Make a choice. Try score = 3. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: if runs a block when its rule is true. Ruby closes this block with end.

blocks.text: Install Ruby 3.1 or later. Save one example as lesson.rb and run ruby lesson.rb in a terminal.

blocks.title: Make a choice
blocks.code:
score = 8
if score >= 5
  puts "Pass"
else
  puts "Try again"
end

blocks.text: The score passes the test. Only the first puts runs.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Remember the final end for the if block.
